title_zh: 没人要的 6 倍市盈率股
structure: 伴随状语 + 分词前置
intro_zh: 摩根士丹利的访谈节目 Hard Lessons，主持人 Iliana Bouzali 请 Druckenmiller 讲一笔最近出手早的股票交易。他挑了一笔一点也不性感的：以色列仿制药公司 Teva，6 倍市盈率、价值派和成长派都不要，他赌管理层转型，半年翻倍；接着讲他为什么看不懂生物科技也敢重仓，以及从索罗斯身上学到的「仓位大小」。

sents.en: I've been privy to some of your equity trades over the past year or so, where it did feel you were early.
sents.zh: 过去一年左右，我有幸看到你的一些股票交易，感觉你出手确实很早。

sents.en: And I'm curious if you can maybe take us through one or two and how they came together.
sents.zh: 我很好奇，你能不能挑一两笔，讲讲它们是怎么成形的。

sents.en: I'll pick one that might surprise you because it's not very sexy and it's not AI or anything, but I think it's a good example of our process at Duquesne.
sents.zh: 我挑一笔可能会让你意外的，因为它一点也不性感，也跟 AI 什么的都不沾边，但我觉得它很能说明我们在 Duquesne 的做事流程。

sents.en: In the middle of last summer, and toward the fall, the AI thing started to get, let me say, disturbingly heated and started at least to have some rhyme with what I went through in '99, 2000 and we were looking for other areas.
sents.zh: 去年仲夏到入秋的时候，AI 那波开始变得——怎么说呢——热得让人不安，至少开始和我在 1999、2000 年经历过的那一幕有几分相似，所以我们在找别的方向。

sents.en: The group brought in a company, Teva Pharmaceuticals.
sents.zh: 团队带来了一家公司：梯瓦制药（Teva Pharmaceuticals）。

sents.en: So Teva was this, apparently, if you didn't know what was going on, boring generic drug company out of Israel, selling at six times earnings.
sents.zh: Teva 这家公司，如果你不了解内情，看上去就是一家无聊的以色列仿制药公司，市盈率只有 6 倍。

hl.note: 分词短语补充：先说是什么公司，再用 selling at… 补一句它的状态。中文说「一家只卖 6 倍市盈率的公司」，英文把这部分挪到句尾。

sents.en: So, we met with the company.
sents.zh: 于是我们去见了公司。

sents.en: Big transition going on.
sents.zh: 公司正在大转型。

hl.note: 名词 + -ing 独立成句：口语里省掉 There was，一句话交代「正在大转型」。

sents.en: Richard Francis had come in who ran the same playbook at Sandoz.
sents.zh: Richard Francis 刚上任，他在山德士（Sandoz）就用过同一套打法。

sents.en: Very impressed with him— knew how to take low-hanging fruit in terms of operating efficiency.
sents.zh: 我们对他印象很深——他知道怎么在经营效率上先摘低垂的果子。

sents.en: But, much more importantly, he was taking them from a generic drug company to a growth company by embracing biosimilars, replacing the generic drugs, which that's why they were six times earnings with biosimilars and even some actual drugs.
sents.zh: 但更重要得多的是，他在把公司从一家仿制药公司变成一家成长型公司：主推生物类似药，用生物类似药、甚至一些真正的创新药，去替代那些仿制药——仿制药正是它只有 6 倍市盈率的原因。

hl.text: by embracing biosimilars, replacing the generic drugs
hl.note: by + -ing 说手段，后面再挂一个 replacing… 分词短语补充「同时替代掉什么」。

sents.en: The amazing thing is, the investor base were value investors, so they hated it.
sents.zh: 妙就妙在，它的投资者都是价值投资者，所以他们很讨厌这个转型。

sents.en: So, the stock sat there at six times earnings, while you could see this incredible management initiative going on.
sents.zh: 于是股价就在 6 倍市盈率上趴着，而你明明看得到管理层在推进一个了不起的计划。

hl.text: while you could see this incredible management initiative going on
hl.note: see + 名词 + -ing：看见某事正在进行。while 引出对比：股价趴着，而计划在推进。

sents.en: And, no one really believed him.
sents.zh: 而且，没人真的相信他。

sents.en: And again, growth investors didn't want it because they hadn't made the transition yet.
sents.zh: 再说，成长型投资者不想要它，因为它还没完成转型。

sents.en: Value investors didn't want it and were actually selling it because he was doing a growth strategy.
sents.zh: 价值投资者也不想要，甚至在卖，因为他走的是成长路线。

sents.en: So that was about six or seven months ago when the stock was $16.
sents.zh: 那大概是六七个月前，股价 16 美元的时候。

sents.en: And today it's $32 and not much has happened.
sents.zh: 现在是 32 美元了，其实也没发生多少事。

sents.en: Other than he's proved biosimilars, they've come up with a drug that's not a generic.
sents.zh: 无非是他证明了生物类似药这条路走得通，他们也拿出了一款非仿制的药。

sents.en: So it's re-rated from six times earnings to, I guess, 11.5 or 12 times earnings.
sents.zh: 所以估值从 6 倍市盈率重估到了，我估计，11.5 或 12 倍。

sents.en: So, it was a whole different set of circumstances but it encapsulates what we look at.
sents.zh: 所以那是一套完全不同的情形，但它浓缩了我们看问题的方式。

sents.en: If you look at today, you're not going to make any money.
sents.zh: 如果你只看今天，你赚不到任何钱。

sents.en: If you try and look ahead and what might change and how investors might perceive something ahead.
sents.zh: 你得试着往前看：什么可能改变、投资者以后可能会怎么看待一件事。

sents.en: This one happened a little more quicker than I thought, but that would be a recent name.
sents.zh: 这一笔兑现得比我想的要快一点，但这算是最近的一个例子。

sents.en: Fascinating and very intriguing.
sents.zh: 很有意思，也很耐人寻味。

sents.en: I say it's intriguing because I think many people, maybe people not in the market, but certainly many people, when they think of Stan Druckenmiller, they think of a huge macro investor.
sents.zh: 我说耐人寻味，是因为很多人——也许不是市场里的人，但肯定很多人——一想到 Stan Druckenmiller，就会想到一位超级宏观投资人。

sents.en: And I have seen you dabble— more than dabble— really go into areas of the market, especially in equities, that are much more niche, such as healthcare or biotech.
sents.zh: 而我见过你涉足——不只是涉足——是真正深入市场里一些细分得多的领域，尤其是股票，比如医疗或者生物科技。

sents.en: And my question is, do you have to be an expert, an analyst, someone that understands the whole pipeline of drugs to get that right?
sents.zh: 我的问题是：你得是专家、是分析师、是看得懂整条药物管线的人，才能做对吗？

sents.en: Thank God the answer is an emphatic no.
sents.zh: 谢天谢地，答案是斩钉截铁的「不用」。

sents.en: But I've got to have an expert at Duquesne who is, and trust his judgment, and then I've got to have a feel for how the market will embrace the change he's describing.
sents.zh: 但我在 Duquesne 得有一位这样的专家，并且信任他的判断；然后我还得能感觉到，市场会怎样接受他描述的那种变化。

sents.en: But we did make a big move into biotech.
sents.zh: 不过我们确实大举进了生物科技。

sents.en: I could sense that there was a potential leadership change just because of the phobia around AI.
sents.zh: 我能感觉到，光是因为大家对 AI 的恐惧，领涨板块就有可能换人。

sents.en: And, I knew because I've been on the board of Memorial Sloan-Kettering for 30 years, that probably the best use case out there of AI is biotech through drug discovery, diagnostics, monitoring everything.
sents.zh: 而且我在纪念斯隆-凯特琳癌症中心的董事会待了 30 年，所以我知道，AI 最好的应用场景大概就是生物科技：药物发现、诊断、监测，什么都包括。

sents.en: So, biotech had been on its butt for like four years.
sents.zh: 当时生物科技已经趴了大概四年。

sents.en: I also grew up with technical analysis and you could see the momentum changing.
sents.zh: 我也是看技术分析长大的，你能看到动能在转变。

hl.text: you could see the momentum changing
hl.note: see + 宾语 + -ing：看到动能正在转变，-ing 表示「正在发生的过程」。

sents.en: So, that was the theory behind biotech.
sents.zh: 这就是我们做生物科技的逻辑。

sents.en: But honestly, when the analysts start talking about genetic sequencing and gene editing and proteins it's going right over Stan's head.
sents.zh: 但老实说，分析师一聊起基因测序、基因编辑、蛋白质，Stan 就完全听不懂了。

sents.en: But I get their level of enthusiasm.
sents.zh: 但我能感受到他们有多兴奋。

sents.en: We have a very good biotech team.
sents.zh: 我们有一支很强的生物科技团队。

sents.en: That's really important because I trust them.
sents.zh: 这一点非常重要，因为我信任他们。

sents.en: And when they're really enthusiastic, that's as important to me as the actual facts, because I'm not smart enough to understand a lot of the actual facts.
sents.zh: 当他们真的很兴奋的时候，这对我来说和实际数据一样重要，因为很多实际数据我根本没聪明到能看懂。

sents.en: So you filter not just the data, but the people that work for you.
sents.zh: 所以你不只是筛选数据，也在筛选替你工作的人。

sents.en: Yeah.
sents.zh: 对。

sents.en: My advantage is not IQ.
sents.zh: 我的优势不是智商。

sents.en: It's trigger pulling.
sents.zh: 是敢扣扳机。

sents.en: I admit it's some kind of intelligence, but my mother-in-law says I'm an idiot savant.
sents.zh: 我承认这也算某种聪明，但我丈母娘说我是「白痴天才」。

sents.en: I wasn't in the top 10% of my class.
sents.zh: 我在班上连前 10% 都没进。

sents.en: A lot of people think I'm smarter than I am because I'm good at our business.
sents.zh: 很多人以为我比实际更聪明，因为我在我们这行做得好。

sents.en: But I have a very narrow form of intelligence that allows me to love and play this game.
sents.zh: 但我的聪明很窄，刚好让我热爱、也玩得转这个游戏。

sents.en: I know many people who would love to get inside your head and understand your mental models.
sents.zh: 我知道很多人都想钻进你的脑子，弄懂你的思维模型。

sents.en: You spoke to us about your way of thinking.
sents.zh: 你跟我们讲过你的思考方式。

sents.en: And I have a really honest, basic question: How much of it can be taught and how much of it is innate?
sents.zh: 我有个很老实、很基础的问题：这里面有多少是能教的，多少是天生的？

sents.en: Look, I, I was given a gift.
sents.zh: 这么说吧，我是被赋予了一种天赋。

sents.en: I don't know why I was given the gift, but I have this gift and it's for compounding money.
sents.zh: 我不知道为什么是我，但我有这个天赋，而且是复利赚钱的天赋。

sents.en: Certainly part of is innate.
sents.zh: 当然，有一部分是天生的。

sents.en: You either have the skill set for this business or you don't.
sents.zh: 这一行需要的那套本事，你要么有，要么没有。

sents.en: Having said that, I had a great mentor in Pittsburgh when I started out, and I find it very common that great investors have incredible mentors.
sents.zh: 话虽如此，我刚入行时在匹兹堡遇到了一位很棒的导师，而且我发现，伟大的投资人身边通常都有了不起的导师。

hl.note: 完成式分词前置：「话虽如此」。先认可上一句，再转折，口语里极常用。

sents.en: So to me, it's a necessary condition that you have sort of this innate skill set or gift, but it's almost a necessary condition on top of it that you have a mentor.
sents.zh: 所以在我看来，你得有这种天生的本事或天赋，这是必要条件；但在此之上，有一位导师几乎也是必要条件。

sents.en: I'm sure there's some people out there that that's not true of, but for me it was a combination.
sents.zh: 我相信外面有些人不是这样，但对我来说，两者缺一不可。

sents.en: I was very lucky to have two mentors.
sents.zh: 我很幸运，有过两位导师。

sents.en: One, I basically learned all the kind of stuff we're talking about.
sents.zh: 第一位，我们现在聊的这些东西，基本都是跟他学的。

sents.en: And then Soros.
sents.zh: 然后是索罗斯。

sents.en: It's funny, when I went there, I thought I would learn what makes the yen in the market go up and move.
sents.zh: 说来好笑，我去他那儿的时候，以为能学到是什么让日元、让市场涨跌。

sents.en: Immodestly, I learned I knew much more about that than he did.
sents.zh: 说句不谦虚的，我发现这方面我懂得比他多得多。

sents.en: What I learned from him was sizing.
sents.zh: 我从他那儿学到的是仓位大小。

sents.en: It's not whether you're right or wrong, it's how much you make when you're right and how much you lose when you're wrong.
sents.zh: 关键不在于你对还是错，而在于你对的时候赚多少，错的时候亏多少。

sents.en: And that was a, that was an invaluable lesson.
sents.zh: 那是无比宝贵的一课。

sents.en: So, you can have something innate.
sents.zh: 所以，你可以有天生的东西。

sents.en: But if you don't have mentors and people to teach you, you're not going to maximize it as much as you do when you do have them.
sents.zh: 但如果没有导师、没有人教你，你就没法把它发挥到有人教你时那么大。

shadow.tips: 断句：So TEva was this, / apPARently, / if you didn't KNOW what was going ON, / BORing generic drug company / out of ISrael, / SELLing at SIX times EARNings. 插入语压低声音快读；selling 前停顿。
断句：So the STOCK sat there / at SIX times earnings, / while you could SEE / this inCREDible management iNItiative / going ON. sat there 连读 sa-there；going on 收尾。
断句：I ALso grew UP / with TECHnical analysis / and you could SEE / the MOmentum CHANGing. grew up 连读 grew-wup；see 后小停。
断句：HAVing said THAT, / I had a GREAT MENtor in PITTSburgh / when I started OUT, / and I find it VEry COMmon / that great investors have inCREDible mentors. having said that 一口气、降调。
断句：It's NOT whether you're RIGHT or WRONG, / it's how MUCH you MAKE when you're RIGHT / and how much you LOSE when you're WRONG. 两个 how much 平行，节奏一致。

questions: Why did Druckenmiller start looking away from AI in the middle of last year?
Describe Teva before the trade. (Try: "It was a boring generic drug company, selling at…")
Why did neither value investors nor growth investors want the stock?
Does he need to understand the science to invest in biotech? What does he rely on instead?
What did he learn from Soros, and why does it matter more than being right?
Is your trading skill more innate or taught? (Try: "Having said that, …")

chunks.zh: 先摘低垂的果子、先做容易的

chunks.en: If you look at today, you're not going to make any money
It's not whether you're right or wrong, it's how much you make when you're right
chunks.zh: 关键不在对错，而在对的时候赚多少
